A.primary: continuous capsule/sphere graph plus confidence-controlled Monte Carlo
A.fatal_risk: periodic boundary or confidence criterion implemented incorrectly

C.primary: forecast plus decomposed multi-region scheduling and storage LP
C.fatal_risk: 50000-task nonpreemptive scheduling exceeds compute budget or violates deadlines

selection_reason: A is fully self-contained, has small deterministic Q1 instances, a falsifiable continuous-geometry core, tractable stochastic experiments and direct uncertainty reporting.
switch_condition: Switch to B only if periodic capsule distances fail independent verification or a pilot cannot complete 100 Monte Carlo trials within the declared budget.
